and fix their hearts on the pilgrim highways.
When they travel through the Baca Valley, they make it a land of springs;
the early rain wraps it in blessings.
They walk on from strength to strength,
till every one of them comes before God in Zion.
LORD God of Armies, hear my prayer;
turn your ear to me, God of Jacob! Selah
God, see our shield;
look with care on the face of your anointed one.
Truly, one day spent in your courts is worth more than a thousand anywhere else;
I would choose to stand at the threshold of my God’s house
over living in the tents of wicked people.
For the LORD God is both sun and shield;
the LORD gives favor and honor;
from those who walk blamelessly he keeps back nothing good.
LORD of Armies,
how blessed is anyone who trusts in you!

fields.title: Psalm 85
fields.body_html:
Loyal love and faithfulness meet

For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.

You were pleased with your land, LORD;
you brought Jacob’s fortunes back.
You took away the guilt of your people
and covered over all their sins. Selah
You drew back all your fury;
you turned away from your blazing anger.
Bring us back, God who saves us,
and put an end to your displeasure with us.
Will you be angry with us for all time?
Will you stretch out your anger to every generation?
Will you not bring us back to life once more,
and let your people be glad in you?
Let us see your loyal love, LORD,
and give us your salvation.
I am listening for what God, the LORD, will say:
he will speak of peace to his people, to those who are loyal to him;
only let them not slide back into foolishness.
Truly his salvation is close at hand for those who fear him,
so that glory will settle in our land.
Loyal love and faithfulness meet as friends;
righteousness and peace greet each other with a kiss.
Faithfulness grows up out of the earth,
and righteousness gazes down from heaven.
The LORD will surely give good things,
and our soil will bring forth its crops.
Righteousness will walk ahead of him
and make a road for his steps.

fields.title: Psalm 86
fields.body_html:
Unite my heart to fear your name

A prayer of David.

LORD, turn your ear toward me and answer,
because I am afflicted and in need.
Protect my life, for I am loyal to you. You are my God; rescue me, your servant,
for I trust in you.
Lord, show me your favor;
I keep calling to you the whole day through.
Make your servant glad,
for my heart reaches out to you, Lord.
For you, Lord, are good and quick to forgive,
rich in loyal love to everyone who calls to you.
LORD, turn your ear to my prayer;
pay attention to my voice as I plead for mercy.
On my day of trouble I cry out to you,
sure that you will answer.
Lord, no god is like you,
and no one has done works like yours.
Every nation you formed will come and bow low before you, Lord,
and give glory to your name.
For you are great, a worker of wonders;
only you are God.
LORD, teach me your way,
and I will live by your truth;
give me a heart set on one thing, to revere your name.
Lord my God, I will thank you with my whole heart
and honor your name for all time.
For your loyal love for me is great;
you have pulled me out of deepest Sheol.
God, the proud have come at me,
and a pack of brutal people is hunting for my life;
they do not keep you in view.
But you, Lord, are a God full of compassion and grace,
slow to grow angry,
overflowing with loyal love and faithfulness.
Turn to me and show me your favor;
lend your servant your strength,
and rescue the son of your servant woman.
Give me a sign that you mean me good,
so that those who hate me see it and are left ashamed,
because you, LORD, have come to my aid and brought me comfort.

fields.title: Psalm 87
fields.body_html:
The nations born in Zion

Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.

The city he founded stands on the holy mountains.
The gates of Zion are dearer to the LORD
than all the places where Jacob’s people live.
City of God,
splendid things are said of you. Selah
“Among those who know me I will name Rahab and Babylon;
see Philistia and Tyre, and Cush as well:
‘This one was born there.’”
And of Zion people will say, “Every one of them was born in her,”
and it is the Most High who will make her secure.
As the LORD lists the peoples in his record,
he will write, “This one was born there.” Selah
Those who sing and those who dance will say,
“All my springs rise in you.”

fields.title: Psalm 88
fields.body_html:
A prayer from the darkness

A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the music director. On mahalath leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.

LORD, God who saves me,
I have cried for help by day, and at night I am before you.
Let my prayer make its way into your presence;
bend down and hear me as I cry.
For I have had my fill of troubles,
and my life has come to the edge of Sheol.
I am reckoned with those who descend into the pit;
I have become like someone with no strength left.
I am turned loose among the dead,
like those killed in battle who lie buried, whom you no longer keep in mind,
who are beyond the reach of your hand.
You have laid me at the bottom of the pit,
in places of darkness, in the deep waters.
Your fury presses down on me;
you have crushed me under all your waves. Selah
You have driven my friends away from me
and made me loathsome to them;
I am shut in, with no way out.
My eyes are worn out with misery.
Day after day I call on you, LORD,
holding out my hands to you.
Are your wonders done for the dead?
Do the spirits of the dead stand up to give you thanks? Selah
Does anyone tell of your loyal love in the grave,
or of your faithfulness in Abaddon?
Will anyone in the darkness know your wonders,
or your saving justice in the land where all is forgotten?
As for me, LORD, I keep calling to you for help;
at dawn my prayer is there to meet you.
LORD, why do you cast me off?
Why do you turn your face away from me?
From my youth I have been afflicted and close to dying;
I bear your terrors and am at a loss.
Your blazing anger has rolled over me;
your terrors have put an end to me.
Like water they swirl around me the whole day;
from every side at once they close in.
You have taken far from me those I love and my friends;
my one companion is the dark.

fields.title: Psalm 89
fields.body_html:
Your promise to David, and the fallen crown

A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

Forever I will sing of the loyal love the LORD has shown;
to one generation after another
my mouth will tell how faithful you are.
For I declare that loyal love is built to last forever;
you have set your faithfulness firm in the heavens.
“With the one I chose I have made a covenant;
to David, my servant, I have given my oath:
‘I will make your line secure forever
and make your throne stand for every generation.’” Selah
The heavens give thanks for your wonders, LORD,
and for your faithfulness in the gathering of the holy ones.
For who in the clouds above is the LORD’s equal?
Which of the heavenly powers is like the LORD?
God is held in great awe in the court of the holy ones,
and feared above all who stand around him.
LORD God of Armies,
who is as strong as you, LORD?
Your faithfulness surrounds you on every side.
You are master of the proud sea;
when its waves rear up, you hush them.
You crushed Rahab like one cut down in battle;
your powerful arm sent your enemies running.
The heavens are yours, and the earth is yours as well;
you laid the foundations of the world and of everything in it.
North and south are your creation;
Tabor and Hermon ring with joy at your name.
Yours is an arm full of might;
your hand has strength, and your right hand is lifted high.
Your throne rests on what is right and just;
loyal love and faithfulness walk ahead of you.
How blessed are the people who have learned to shout for joy in worship;
LORD, they live in the light of your presence.
They find joy in your name the whole day,
and your righteousness raises them up.
For you are the splendor of their strength,
and by your goodwill our strength is raised high.
For the shield that protects us is the LORD’s,
and the king who rules us belongs to the Holy One of Israel.
Long ago you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones
and said, “I have laid help on a mighty man;
I have lifted high a man I chose from the people.
I found David, my servant;
I have poured my holy oil on him to make him king,
and my hand will stay with him,
and my arm will make him strong.
No enemy will outwit him,
and no one who does wrong will bring him low.
I will shatter his foes before his eyes
and cut down the people who hate him.
My faithfulness and my loyal love will stay beside him,
and through my name his strength will rise.
I will put the sea under his hand
and the rivers under his right hand.
He will call to me, ‘It is you who are my Father,
my God, my rock where I am safe.’
And I will give him the rank of firstborn,
set high above every king on earth.
I will keep my loyal love for him forever,
and my covenant with him will hold fast.
I will make his line last for all time,
and his throne as long as the sky endures.
If his descendants abandon my instruction
and do not live by my rulings,
if they treat my decrees as nothing
and do not keep my commands,
then I will call their rebellion to account with the rod
and their guilt with beatings.
But my loyal love I will never cut off from him,
and my faithfulness will not prove false.
I will never desecrate my covenant;
what my lips have spoken I will not change.
I have sworn by my holiness, once and for all,
that I will never lie to David:
his line will last forever,
and his throne will stand before me like the sun,
it will be made firm forever like the moon,
that faithful witness in the clouds.” Selah
But now you have thrown him off and rejected him;
you are enraged with your anointed king.
You have disowned the covenant with your servant;
you have thrown his crown in the dirt and defiled it.
You have torn gaps in all his walls
and left his fortresses in rubble.
Everyone who comes along the road has robbed him;
his neighbors treat him with scorn.
You have made his foes’ right hand strong
and filled all his enemies with joy.
Yes, you have blunted his sword’s edge
and left him unable to stand in the fight.
You have made his glory fade
and thrown his throne down into the dust.
You have made his young days short
and covered him with disgrace like a cloak. Selah
How long, LORD? Will you keep yourself hidden forever?
Will your anger go on burning like fire?
Remember how brief my life is!
Is it for nothing that you have created every human being?
Who can go on living and never see death?
Who can save their own life from the grip of Sheol? Selah
Lord, where are the acts of loyal love you showed in the past,
the ones you swore to David by your faithfulness?
Lord, keep in mind the scorn heaped on your servants;
I hold within me the insults of all the many peoples,
the insults your enemies have hurled, LORD,
the taunts that have dogged every step of your anointed king.
May the LORD be blessed forever!
Amen and amen.

fields.title: Psalm 90
fields.body_html:
Teach us to count our days

A prayer of Moses, the man of God.

Lord, you have been our home through every generation.
Before the mountains came to birth,
before you labored to bring to birth the earth and all the world,
from the endless past to the endless future you are God.
You make mortals go back to dust;
you say, “Return, children of Adam.”
For in your eyes a thousand years are like yesterday, once it has gone by,
or like one watch of the night.
You wash them away like a flood. They are a passing sleep.
When morning comes they are like grass that springs up again.
In the morning it blooms and grows fresh;
by evening it droops and dries out.
For we are worn away by your anger
and struck with terror by your rage.
You have laid our wrongs out before you;
what we hid is lit up by the light of your face.
All our days slip away under your wrath;
our years end like a sigh.
Our lifetime lasts seventy years, or eighty for the strong;
yet even its best is toil and sorrow,
for it hurries past, and we take flight.
Who knows the force of your anger?
Your fury matches the reverence you deserve.
Teach us, then, to reckon our days rightly,
so that our hearts may grow wise.
Turn back to us, LORD! How long must we wait?
Show pity to your servants.
Fill us with your loyal love at daybreak,
and we will shout for joy and rejoice as long as we live.
Match the days you brought us low with days of gladness,
and the years of hardship we have known with years of joy.
Let your servants see your deeds,
and let their children see your splendor.
May the Lord our God show us his kindness.
Give lasting worth to the work of our hands;
yes, give the work of our hands lasting worth.

fields.title: Psalm 91
fields.body_html:
In the shelter of the Most High

Whoever makes a home under the cover of the Most High
will spend the night in the shade of the Almighty.
This is what I say about the LORD: “He is my shelter and my stronghold,
my God, the one I rely on.”
It is he who will rescue you from the bird-catcher’s trap
and from the plague that destroys.
He will spread his feathers over you, and beneath his wings you will find shelter.
His faithfulness surrounds you like a shield and a wall.
You need not be afraid of the terrors that come at night
or the arrow that speeds by in daylight,
or the disease that prowls in the dark,
or the destruction that ravages at noon.
A thousand may drop beside you,
ten thousand close by your right hand,
yet it will not reach you.
You will only watch with your own eyes
and see the wicked paid back.
For you, LORD, are my refuge!
You have made the Most High your home.
No evil will strike you;
no plague will get close to your home.
For he will give his angels orders about you,
to protect you wherever you go.
They will carry you in their hands,
and you will not hurt your foot on a stone.
You will walk over lions and cobras;
you will crush young lions and serpents under your feet.
“Those who cling to me with love I will rescue;
I will lift them high out of reach, because they know my name.
They will cry out to me, and I will answer;
in their distress I will stand by them;
I will free them and bring them honor.
I will give them their fill of long life
and show them my saving help.”

fields.title: Psalm 92
fields.body_html:
It is good to give thanks

A psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

It is a good thing to thank the LORD,
to sing and play in praise of your name, Most High,
to tell of your loyal love at sunrise
and of your faithfulness through the nights,
with the ten-stringed instrument and the harp,
to the sounding music of the lyre.
For your deeds, LORD, have filled me with joy;
I sing out over all that your hands have made.
LORD, how great the things you do!
How very deep your plans!
Senseless people do not know it;
fools cannot grasp this:
though the wicked shoot up like green plants
and all who do wrong are in bloom,
it is only so that they may be destroyed for all time.
But you, LORD,
are enthroned on high for all time.
Look at your enemies, LORD!
Look, your enemies are doomed;
everyone who does evil will be driven apart.
But you have made me strong like a wild ox;
fresh oil has been poured over me.
My eyes have looked in triumph on those who lay in wait for me;
my ears have heard what became of the evildoers who rose up against me.
The righteous will thrive like the palm tree
and rise tall as a cedar on Lebanon.
Rooted in the LORD’s house,
they will bloom in the courtyards of our God.
Even when they are old they will still bear fruit;
they will stay rich with sap and green,
bearing witness that the LORD is just:
my rock, in whom nothing is crooked.

fields.title: Psalm 93
fields.body_html:
The LORD is King

The LORD is King! He has put on majesty like a robe;
the LORD has dressed himself and tied on strength like a belt.
The world stands firm; nothing can shake it.
Your throne has stood firm from ancient days;
you have always been.
The rivers have risen, LORD;
the rivers have raised their roar;
the rivers lift high their crashing waves.
Above the roar of the great waters,
above the crash of the ocean’s breakers,
the LORD is majestic on high.
Your decrees can be fully trusted;
holiness suits your house,
LORD, for all time to come.

fields.title: Psalm 94
fields.body_html:
God who judges the earth, rise up

God of retribution, LORD,
God of retribution, shine out!
Stand up, Judge of all the earth,
and give the arrogant what their deeds have earned.
LORD, how much longer will the wicked,
how much longer will the wicked celebrate?
Insolent words gush from them;
everyone who does evil talks big.
They grind down your people, LORD;
they oppress the nation that belongs to you.
Widows and foreigners they put to death;
orphans they murder.
They say, “The LORD is not looking;
Jacob’s God pays no attention.”
Get some understanding, you brutish people!
Fools, when will you start to think wisely?
Will the one who set the ear in place not hear?
Will the one who shaped the eye not see?
Will the one who disciplines nations not correct them,
the one who teaches humans all they know?
The LORD knows what humans are thinking,
and that their thoughts are only a puff of air.
How blessed is the one whom you correct, LORD,
and train through your instruction,
giving them calm in the days of trouble,
while the pit is being dug for the wicked.
The LORD will not reject his people;
he will never desert those who belong to him.
For justice will once again be joined to what is right,
and all who are honest at heart will follow it.
Who will take my side against the wicked?
Who will stand with me against those who do wrong?
If the LORD had not helped me,
I would soon have been living where all is silent.
The moment I said, “My foot is giving way,”
your loyal love, LORD, held me up.
When my worries crowd in on me,
your comfort fills me with joy.
Will a ruling power bent on ruin ever be your partner,
one that uses the law to create misery?
They gather against the righteous to take their lives,
and they condemn innocent people to death.
But the LORD has proved to be my high fortress;
my God has been a rock that shelters me.
He will make their evil recoil on them
and put an end to them through their own wickedness;
the LORD our God will put an end to them.

fields.title: Psalm 95
fields.body_html:
Bow to the King; listen today

Come, let us sing out with joy to the LORD
and raise a glad shout to the Rock who saves us.
Let us go out to meet him with thanks,
and lift a glad shout to him in our songs.
For the LORD is a mighty God,
a mighty King high over all gods,
who holds the deep places of the earth in his hand;
the tops of the mountains are his as well,
the sea belongs to him because he made it,
and his hands shaped the dry ground.
Come, let us bow down to the ground and bend low;
let us kneel in front of the LORD, the one who made us.
For it is he who is our God,
and we are a people he pastures, a flock he tends with his own hand.
Oh, that today you would listen to his voice!
“Do not let your hearts grow hard, as happened at Meribah,
on the day of Massah out in the desert,
when your ancestors put me to the test
and challenged me, even after they had watched my work.
Forty years long I was weary and disgusted with that generation.
I said, ‘These are people whose hearts wander off;
they have never learned my ways.’
So in my anger I took an oath:
‘They will never come into my place of rest.’”

fields.title: Psalm 96
fields.body_html:
A new song for all the earth

Sing a new song to the LORD!
All the earth, sing to the LORD!
Raise your song to the LORD; bless his name.
Day after day announce the good news of how he saves.
Tell the nations of his glory,
and all the peoples of the wonders he has done.
For the LORD is great and worthy of the highest praise;
he must be revered above every god.
For every god the peoples serve is a mere nothing, an idol,
but it was the LORD who made the heavens.
Splendor and majesty stand in his presence;
strength and beauty fill his holy place.
Give the LORD what is due, you families of the nations;
give the LORD glory and might.
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves;
bring a gift and enter his courts.
Bow low before the LORD in holy splendor;
tremble in his presence, all the earth.
Tell the nations, “The LORD is King!
The world stands firm; nothing can make it totter.
He will judge the peoples fairly.”
Let the heavens be full of joy and the earth be glad;
let the sea thunder with all that lives in it.
Let the fields and everything in them celebrate;
then every tree in the woods will cry out with joy,
in the presence of the LORD, for he is on the way, on the way to judge the earth.
He will bring justice to the world
and judge its peoples by his own faithfulness.

fields.title: Psalm 97
fields.body_html:
The LORD is King over all

The LORD is King! Let the earth be glad,
and the many far-off coastlands celebrate.
Clouds and deep darkness surround him;
his throne is built on what is right and just.
Fire marches ahead of him
and burns up his enemies on every side.
The world is lit by the flash of his lightning;
the earth sees it and quakes.
In the presence of the LORD the mountains soften like wax,
in the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
The skies announce that he is righteous,
and every people sees his glory.
Let everyone who serves carved idols be disgraced,
all who brag about worthless gods;
bow down before him, all you gods!
Zion hears of it and is filled with joy;
the towns of Judah celebrate
your acts of justice, LORD.
For it is you, LORD, who are Most High over the whole earth;
you are lifted far above every god.
All who love the LORD, hate what is evil!
He watches over the lives of his faithful people
and rescues them from the power of the wicked.
Light is scattered like seed for the righteous,
and joy for those whose hearts are true.
Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people,
and thank him, calling his holy name to mind.

fields.title: Psalm 98
fields.body_html:
Creation greets its coming Judge

A psalm.

Sing the LORD a new song because of the wonders he has done!
By his own right hand and his holy arm he has won the victory.
The LORD has let his saving power be known;
he has shown his justice openly for the nations to see.
He has kept in mind his loyal love and faithfulness toward the people of Israel;
the farthest places on earth have seen
how our God saves.
Raise a glad shout to the LORD, all the earth;
burst into joyful song and make music!
Make music for the LORD on the lyre,
the lyre and the voice of song!
With trumpets and the ram’s horn sounding,
lift a glad shout before the King, the LORD.
Let the sea and everything in it thunder,
the world and everyone living there.
May the rivers clap their hands,
and the mountains all sing for joy together,
in the presence of the LORD, for he is on the way to judge the earth.
He will govern the world rightly
and the peoples with fairness.

fields.title: Psalm 99
fields.body_html:
Holy is the King enthroned in Zion

The LORD is King; let the peoples shudder!
He is seated on the cherubim as on a throne; let the earth shake!
In Zion the LORD is great;
he towers over all the peoples.
Let the peoples give thanks to your name, great and awe-inspiring.
He is holy!
Mighty King who loves justice,
it is you who have set fairness firmly in place;
you have done what is just and right in Jacob.
Lift high the LORD our God,
and bow low at his footstool.
He is holy!
Among his priests were Moses and Aaron,
and among those who called on his name was Samuel;
they called out to the LORD, and he answered them.
From the pillar of cloud he spoke with them;
they kept the decrees he laid down and the rule he gave them.
LORD our God, it was you who answered them.
To them you were a God who forgives,
yet one who punished their wrongs.
Lift high the LORD our God,
and bow low on his holy hill,
because the LORD our God is holy.

fields.title: Psalm 100
fields.body_html:
All the earth, come in with thanks

A psalm for giving thanks.

Raise a glad shout to the LORD, all the earth!
Serve the LORD and be glad doing it;
come before him with ringing cries of joy.
Be sure of this: the LORD is God!
He is the one who made us, and we belong to him.
We are his people, the flock he pastures.
Come through his gates giving thanks,
into his courtyards with praise;
thank him and bless his name.
For the LORD is good; his loyal love has no end,
and his faithfulness stands from one generation to the next.

fields.title: Psalm 101
fields.body_html:
A king’s vow of integrity

Of David. A psalm.

Loyal love and justice will be my song; LORD, I will make music for you.
I will take care to keep to the blameless way. When will you come to me? Inside my own house I will live with an undivided heart.
I will not fix my eyes on anything vile. I hate the deeds of those who turn away; they will get no hold on me.
A crooked heart will stay far from me; I will not keep company with evil.
Anyone who secretly slanders a neighbor I will destroy; anyone with lofty eyes and a swollen heart I will not put up with.
I will watch for those in the land who are faithful and bring them to live with me; those who walk the blameless way will be my servants.
Deceivers will find no home in my house; liars will not keep their place in my sight.
Each morning I will make an end of the wicked in the land, and rid the city of the LORD of all who do wrong.

fields.title: Psalm 102
fields.body_html:
A prayer from the ashes for Zion

A prayer of someone in deep trouble, who is worn out and pours out a complaint before the LORD.

LORD, listen to my prayer; let my call for help reach you.
Do not turn your face away from me on the day trouble presses me hard. Bend down and listen to me; on the day I call, be quick to answer.
For my days are going up in smoke, and my bones are scorched like a hearth.
My heart is beaten down and dried up like grass; I do not even remember to eat.
All my groaning has worn me down until my bones stick to my skin.
I am like an owl out in the wilderness, a little owl in a place of ruins.
Sleep will not come; I am like a single bird sitting on the housetop.
My enemies scorn me the whole day; those who jeer at me make my name a curse.
For ashes are the bread I eat, and tears fall into what I drink,
because of your fury and your anger; you picked me up and flung me away.
My days are a shadow that stretches out as the sun goes down; I dry up like grass.
But you, LORD, are King on your throne forever, and your name lives on from one generation to the next.
You will stand up and take pity on Zion; the hour to be kind to her is here, the time you set has come.
For your servants treasure her very stones and grieve over her dust.
Then nations will stand in awe of the name of the LORD, and every king on earth will tremble at your glory.
For the LORD will build Zion again; he will be seen in all his glory.
He will listen when the destitute pray and will not wave their prayers aside.
Put this in writing for the generation still to come, and a people that is still to be created will praise the LORD,
that the LORD bent down from his holy heights and looked out from heaven over the earth,
to listen to the moaning of captives and free those marked for death,
so that people may make the LORD’s name known in Zion and sing his praise in Jerusalem,
when nations and kingdoms all gather to serve the LORD.
On the road of life he has worn down my strength and made my days few.
So I say: My God, do not take me away when only half my days are done, you whose years run on from age to age.
Long ago you set the earth on its foundations; the heavens are what your hands have made.
They will come to an end, but you stand firm; all of them will grow old and thin like a cloak. Like worn clothing you will exchange them, and they will be gone.
But you are the one who does not change, and your years will never be finished.
The children of your servants will make their home in the land, and their descendants will be kept safe in your presence.

fields.title: Psalm 103
fields.body_html:
Bless the LORD, my soul

Of David.

Bless the LORD, my soul; let all that is deep within me bless his holy name.
Bless the LORD, my soul, and never forget all that he has done for you,
who pardons all your wrongdoing, who cures every illness you have,
who ransoms your life from the grave, who makes loyal love and compassion your crown,
who fills your life with good things, so that you are made young again like the eagle.
The LORD acts to set things right and gives justice to all who are crushed by others.
He let Moses know his ways and let the people of Israel see what he could do.
Tender and gracious is the LORD, slow to anger, rich in loyal love.
He does not keep bringing charges, and he does not hold on to anger for all time.
He has not treated us as our sins called for, nor paid us back in full for our wrongs.
As far as the sky towers over the earth, so mighty is his loyal love over all who fear him.
As distant as sunrise is from sunset, so distant has he set our rebellious acts from us.
Just as a father feels for his children, the LORD feels tender love for all who fear him.
For he knows what we are made of; he does not forget that we are only dust.
Mortals have days like grass; they bloom like a flower in the open field,
a wind blows across it and it has vanished; its own place will not know it again.
But the loyal love of the LORD lasts from age to age on all who fear him, while his righteousness reaches their children’s children,
for all who hold to his covenant and are careful to carry out what he commands.
The LORD has fixed his throne in heaven; his royal power reigns over all there is.
Bless the LORD, you angels of his, strong warriors who carry out what he says and listen for the sound of his word.
Bless the LORD, all his armies, his attendants who carry out what he wants.
Bless the LORD, all that he has made, everywhere under his rule. Bless the LORD, my soul.

fields.title: Psalm 104
fields.body_html:
The Creator’s world, full of creatures

Bless the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, how great you are! Splendor and majesty are the robes you wear,
you wrap yourself in light as in a cloak and spread out the sky like a tent cloth,
who builds his upper rooms with beams set in the waters above, who turns the clouds into his chariot and travels on the wings of the wind,
who makes the winds his messengers and flames of fire his servants.
He fixed the earth on its bases, never to be toppled, for all time to come.
The deep was the robe you put over it; the waters rose and stood above the mountains.
When you rebuked them, the waters ran; at the roar of your thunder they rushed off,
they went up over the mountains and down into the valleys, to the place you had fixed for them.
You fixed a limit they may not pass; they will not come back to cover the land.
You let springs loose into the stream beds; they find their way between the mountains.
Every creature of the open country drinks from them; there the wild donkeys satisfy their thirst.
Close by them the birds of the air settle and call out from the leafy branches.
From his rooms on high he waters the mountains, and the earth has its fill of the fruit of your work.
He makes grass spring up for the herds and plants for people to tend, so that food comes out of the ground,
wine that brings joy to human hearts, oil that makes faces glow, and bread that keeps people strong.
The LORD’s trees have all the water they need, the cedars he planted on Lebanon,
where birds build their nests, and the stork lives high in the cypress trees.
The wild goats have the high mountains, and the hyraxes take shelter in the crags.
He made the moon for keeping the feasts and seasons; the sun knows the hour it should set.
You send darkness, night comes, and every animal of the woods steals out.
The young lions roar as they hunt, asking God for their meal.
At sunrise they draw back together and settle down to rest in their lairs.
Then human beings head out to their work and keep at their tasks till evening.
LORD, how many and varied your works are! You made them all with skill and wisdom; the earth is crowded with what you have made.
Look at the sea, so vast and reaching out on every side! It swarms with countless creatures, living things tiny and huge.
Ships travel across it, and so does Leviathan, the creature you shaped to play in its waves.
Every one of them waits for you to give them food when it is needed.
You hand it out and they pick it up; you open your hand, and they eat their fill of good things.
If you turn your face away, they panic; if you withdraw their breath, they breathe their last and go back to the dust they came from.
When you send your spirit out, they come into being, and you make the face of the land new.
Let the glory of the LORD stand forever; let the LORD be glad in the things he has made,
who glances at the earth and it quakes, who touches the mountains and they send up smoke.
All my life long I will sing to the LORD; while I am still here I will make music to my God.
Let what I ponder bring him pleasure; as for me, my joy is in the LORD.
Let sinners be wiped out from the earth, and let no wicked people be left. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 105
fields.body_html:
The LORD keeps his promise

Thank the LORD and call on his name; tell every people what he has done.
Sing to him, play and sing his praise; talk of all the wonderful things he has done.
Take pride in his holy name; let all who look to the LORD be glad at heart.
Turn to the LORD and to his strength; come into his presence again and again.
Call to mind the wonders he has worked, his signs, and the verdicts he spoke,
you descendants of his servant Abraham, you children of Jacob, the ones he chose.
He, the LORD, is our God; his rulings reach the whole earth.
He keeps his covenant in mind forever, the promise he laid down for a thousand generations,
the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac,
and he set it in place for Jacob as a decree, for Israel as a covenant that lasts forever,
saying, “The land of Canaan I give to you, a share marked out for you to inherit.”
When they were only a handful of people, a few outsiders living in that land,
wandering from one nation to the next, from one kingdom to another people,
he let no one do them wrong, and he took kings to task over them:
“Do not lay a hand on my anointed ones; do not hurt my prophets.”
He summoned a famine over the land and broke off every supply of bread.
But he had already sent a man on ahead of them: Joseph, who was sold to be a slave.
Shackles bruised his feet, and his neck was locked in iron,
until the day his own words came true; the word of the LORD refined him.
The king sent orders to free him; the ruler of many peoples let him loose.
He put him in charge of his palace and gave him rule over all his wealth,
with power to put his officials in chains if he chose, and to make his counselors wise.
So Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob settled as a guest in the land of Ham.
There he made his people grow greatly in number, until they were too strong for their enemies.
He turned the hearts of the Egyptians to hatred of his people and to scheming against his servants.
He sent his servant Moses, and with him Aaron, his chosen one.
Among the Egyptians they carried out the signs he had spoken of, and wonders throughout the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and the land went dark; and they did not defy his word.
He made their waters blood and left their fish dead.
Frogs swarmed over their land, even into the inner rooms of their kings.
At his command came swarms of flies, and gnats covered every part of their land.
Instead of rain he gave them hail, with fire flashing across their land.
He beat down their grapevines and their fig trees and splintered every tree in their land.
At his word the locusts arrived, swarms of young locusts too many to count,
and they devoured every green plant in their land and swallowed up the harvest of their fields.
And he killed the firstborn of every family in their land, the first sons born of their strength.
He brought his people out carrying silver and gold, and in all his tribes not one person stumbled.
Egypt was happy to see them go, since fear of them had come over its people.
He spread a cloud above them like a screen, and fire to light up the night.
When they asked, he sent quail, and he gave them their fill of bread from heaven.
He opened up a rock and water streamed out, running like a river through the parched land.
For he remembered the holy word he had spoken to Abraham, his servant.
So he led his people out rejoicing, his chosen ones singing aloud for joy.
He gave them the lands of other nations, and they took over what those peoples had worked for,
so that they would keep his decrees and hold fast to his instructions. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 106
fields.body_html:
Israel’s unfaithfulness and God’s mercy

Praise the LORD! Give the LORD thanks, for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever.
Who can put into words the mighty deeds of the LORD or tell out all the praise he deserves?
How blessed are those who hold to justice and do what is right at every moment!
LORD, think of me when you favor your people; come to me with your saving help,
so that I may see the good things you give your chosen ones, be glad with your nation in its gladness, and give glory together with the people who belong to you.
Like our ancestors, we have sinned; we have gone astray and done what is evil.
Our ancestors in Egypt did not take your wonders to heart; they did not remember how great your loyal love was, and at the sea, the Red Sea, they rebelled.
Still he rescued them, for the honor of his name, to show how mighty he is.
He spoke sharply to the Red Sea, and it went dry; he brought them over the deep places as if across open country.
He rescued them from the power of the one who hated them and set them free from the enemy’s grip.
The waters closed over their enemies; not a single one remained.
Then they trusted his promises and sang songs of praise to him.
How quickly they forgot his deeds! They would not wait to hear what he intended.
Out in the wilderness their cravings ran wild, and in the wasteland they challenged God.
He granted what they demanded, but with it he sent a disease that wasted them away.
They turned jealous of Moses there in the camp, and of Aaron, the man set apart as holy to the LORD.
The ground split open and swallowed Dathan; it closed over Abiram and his followers.
Then fire flared up in their company, and flames devoured the wicked.
They made a calf at Horeb and bowed low before an idol of molten metal.
They traded God, their glory, for the figure of a grass-eating bull.
They forgot God their Savior and the great deeds he had worked in Egypt,
wonders in the land of Ham, fearsome acts at the Red Sea.
So he said he would wipe them out; but Moses, his chosen one, stood in the gap before him to turn his anger away so that he would not destroy them.
They looked down on the land of delight and put no faith in what he had promised,
They muttered in their tents and would not heed the voice of the LORD.
So he raised his hand in an oath that they would die in the wilderness,
and that their children would be brought down among the nations and scattered through foreign lands.
They bound themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate offerings made to the dead.
They made him angry by what they did, and plague burst out among them.
Then Phinehas rose and stepped in, and the plague was halted.
And that deed was counted to him as righteousness for all generations, for all time.
At the waters of Meribah they made him angry, and Moses paid dearly because of them,
for they defied his Spirit, and Moses let hasty words pass his lips.
They did not wipe out the peoples the LORD had told them to destroy,
instead they mixed with the nations and took up their ways.
They served those nations’ idols, which turned into a trap for them.
They even offered up their own sons and daughters to demons.
They spilled the blood of the innocent, their own sons and daughters, slaughtered as offerings to Canaan’s idols, and the land was made unclean by bloodshed.
They made themselves unclean by what they did and were unfaithful like a prostitute in their ways.
So the LORD burned with anger against his people and came to loathe his own possession.
He handed them over to other nations, and people who hated them became their masters.
Their enemies crushed them and forced them to bow under their power.
Again and again he rescued them, but they kept to their own rebellious plans and sank down in their sin.
Even so, he saw the trouble they were in when their cry reached him.
For their sake he called to mind his covenant and turned from his anger, because his loyal love is so great.
He moved all those who had carried them off to treat them with pity.
Rescue us, LORD our God, and bring us back together from among the nations, so that we may thank your holy name and make our boast in praising you.
May the LORD, the God of Israel, be blessed from ages past to ages to come! And let all the people answer, “Amen!” Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 107
fields.body_html:
Let the rescued give thanks

Give the LORD thanks, for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever.
Let those whom the LORD has bought back say it, those he freed from the grip of the enemy,
and brought them in from other lands, from the east and the west, the north and the south.
Some strayed through the wilderness, along a barren track, and found no town to live in.
Starving and parched, they felt their life draining out of them.
In their distress they called out to the LORD, and he rescued them from their troubles.
He guided them on a level road until they came to a town to live in.
Let them give the LORD thanks for his loyal love and for the wonders he works for humankind.
For he gives drink to those who are parched and fills the starving with good food.
Some lived in darkness, in the blackest gloom, held fast in misery and iron,
because they had defied what God said and scorned the purpose of the Most High.
So he broke their pride with hard labor; they fell, and no one came to help.
In their distress they called out to the LORD, and he saved them from their troubles.
He led them out of the darkness and the blackest gloom and snapped the chains that held them.
Let them give the LORD thanks for his loyal love and for the wonders he works for humankind.
For he smashes doors of bronze and hacks through bars of iron.
Some were fools, and their rebellious ways and their wrongdoing brought suffering on them.
They could not stand the sight of food, and came close to the gates of death.
In their distress they called out to the LORD, and he saved them from their troubles.
He sent his word and made them well; he pulled them out of the pit of death.
Let them give the LORD thanks for his loyal love and for the wonders he works for humankind.
Let them bring offerings of thanks and with glad shouts recount what he has done.
Some sailed out to sea in ships, trading over the vast waters,
they saw for themselves what the LORD does, his marvels out on the deep.
At his word a gale sprang up and drove the waves of the sea high.
Up they were tossed to the sky, and down into the depths; in such danger their nerve gave way.
They lurched and swayed like someone drunk, and all their skill at sea came to nothing.
In their distress they called out to the LORD, and he brought them out from their troubles.
He turned the gale into a gentle breath, and the waves around them fell silent.
How glad they were when all grew still! And he brought them to the harbor they longed for.
Let them give the LORD thanks for his loyal love and for the wonders he works for humankind.
Let them lift him high where the people gather and praise him where the elders sit in council.
He can dry up rivers until they are desert and turn springs of water into parched land,
and rich farmland into a salt flat, for the evil done by those who live there.
He makes the desert a pool of water and dry country into bubbling springs.
There he settles the hungry, and they build a town to live in.
They seed the fields and plant vines, and gather a rich harvest.
He blesses them, and their numbers grow and grow; he does not let their herds dwindle.
Then they dwindle and are brought down by cruel rule, disaster and grief.
He heaps scorn on the powerful and leaves them lost in a wasteland without a road.
But he raises the needy from their misery and makes their families grow like flocks of sheep.
Those who live upright lives look on with joy, and all wickedness has nothing more to say.
Whoever is wise should mark these things and ponder the loyal love the LORD has shown again and again.

fields.title: Psalm 108
fields.body_html:
Morning praise and a prayer for victory

A song. A psalm of David.

My heart is firm, God; I will sing and play songs of praise with all my soul.
Come awake, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
LORD, I will thank you before all peoples; I will sing your praise in every nation.
For your loyal love towers above the heavens, and your faithfulness rises to the clouds.
God, be lifted high above the heavens; let your glory spread over all the earth.
So that those you love may be set free, bring rescue with your right hand and answer me!
God has spoken from his holy place: “I will rejoice as I share out Shechem and mark off the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead belongs to me, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the helmet on my head, Judah the staff of my rule.
Moab is my washing bowl; on Edom I toss my sandal; I raise the victor’s shout over Philistia!”
Who will take me into the walled city? Who will guide me all the way to Edom?
Is it not you, God, who rejected us and no longer march out with our armies?
Help us against the enemy, for any rescue that people can bring is useless.
With God on our side we will fight with courage; he is the one who will crush our foes underfoot.

fields.title: Psalm 109
fields.body_html:
God of my praise, do not be silent

For the music director. Of David. A psalm.

God whom I praise, do not keep silent.
For the wicked have opened deceitful mouths against me; they speak to me with lies on their tongues.
They have hemmed me in with hateful words and attacked me for no reason.
They repay my love by accusing me, yet I go on praying.
They hand me evil for the good I did, and hatred in exchange for my love.
Put someone wicked in charge of him; may an accuser take his stand at his right side.
When he is tried, may the verdict be guilty, and may his very prayer count as sin.
May his life be short, and may someone else take over his position.
May his children lose their father and his wife be left a widow.
May his children roam about as beggars, searching for food far from their ruined homes.
May the moneylender snatch up all he owns, and strangers carry off what he worked for.
May no one keep showing him loyal love, and no one take pity on his orphaned children.
May his line come to an end, their name erased within a generation.
May the LORD keep in mind the guilt of his ancestors, and may his mother’s sin never be erased.
May their sins stay always before the LORD, and may he wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
For he never thought to show loyal love; he hounded the poor and needy and the heartbroken to their death.
He loved to curse, and the curse has come back on him; he had no wish to bless, and blessing has stayed far from him.
He put on cursing as his clothing; it seeped like water into his inner being and soaked like oil deep into his bones.
May it be the cloak he wraps around him, the belt he ties on every day.
May this be how the LORD repays my accusers, those who speak evil against me.
But you, Lord GOD, take my side for the honor of your name; rescue me, for your loyal love is good.
For I am poor and helpless; my heart within me is pierced through.
Like a shadow lengthening at dusk I pass away; I am brushed off like a locust.
My knees buckle from going without food, and my body has grown thin, with no fat left on it.
They treat me with contempt; when they catch sight of me, they shake their heads at me.
LORD my God, come to my help! Save me, true to your loyal love.
Make them see that this is your own hand at work, that you, LORD, are the one who did it.
They may curse, but you will bless; when they rise against me they will be disgraced, while your servant rejoices.
May my accusers be dressed in dishonor and wrapped in their own shame like a cloak.
My lips will thank the LORD over and over; I will praise him in the middle of the crowd.
For he takes his place at the right side of the needy, to save them from those who would sentence them to death.

fields.title: Psalm 110
fields.body_html:
A king and priest forever

Of David. A psalm.

The LORD declares to my lord: “Take your seat at my right hand, while I lay your enemies beneath your feet like a footstool.”
From Zion the LORD will stretch out the scepter of your power: rule where your enemies surround you!
Your people offer themselves gladly on the day you march out in strength, in splendor and holiness. Out of the dawn’s womb your youth comes to you fresh as the dew.
The LORD has taken an oath and will not take it back: “You are a priest for all time, after the pattern of Melchizedek.”
The Lord stands at your right side, and when the day of his anger comes, he shatters kings.
He passes judgment on the nations, and the dead lie everywhere; he crushes the leaders over the wide earth.
On the way he drinks from a stream, and so he stands with his head held high.

fields.title: Psalm 111
fields.body_html:
The great works of the LORD

Praise the LORD! I will thank the LORD with all my heart where upright people gather, in the whole assembly.
The deeds of the LORD are great; all who take pleasure in them search them out.
Everything he does shines with splendor and majesty, and his righteousness stands for all time.
He has set up a memorial of his wonderful deeds; the LORD is gracious and tender in mercy.
He feeds those who fear him and keeps his covenant in mind for all time.
He made the might of his deeds known to his people when he gave them the nations’ land to inherit.
All that his hands do is faithful and just; every one of his precepts can be trusted.
They stand secure for all time, framed with faithfulness and integrity.
He sent his people redemption and set his covenant in place for all time. Holy and awe-inspiring is his name!
The fear of the LORD is where wisdom begins; all who carry them out show good sense. His praise stands for all time.

fields.title: Psalm 112
fields.body_html:
The life of one who fears the LORD

Praise the LORD! How blessed are all who fear the LORD, whose great delight is in his commands!
Their descendants will be powerful in the land, for the family of the upright is blessed.
Their houses are full of wealth and riches, and their righteousness stands for all time.
When darkness falls, a light shines out for the upright: they are gracious, full of compassion, and righteous.
Things go well for people who are kind and lend to others, and who handle their dealings with justice.
They will never be overthrown; the righteous will be remembered for all time.
Bad news does not frighten them; their hearts stand firm because they trust in the LORD.
Their hearts are held steady and they will not be afraid, until they see what becomes of their enemies.
They have given generously, spreading their gifts among the needy; their righteousness stands for all time, and their strength will rise in honor.
The wicked see it and are galled; they grind their teeth and melt away; what the wicked long for is lost.

fields.title: Psalm 113
fields.body_html:
The LORD lifts up the lowly

Praise the LORD! You who serve the LORD, give praise; give praise to the name of the LORD!
May the name of the LORD be blessed from now on and for all time.
From where the sun comes up to where it goes down, the name of the LORD is worthy of praise.
The LORD is lifted high over every nation; his glory rises above the heavens.
Who can compare with the LORD our God, who has taken his seat on high,
who bends low to see what is in the heavens and on the earth?
He lifts the poor up out of the dust and raises those in need from the ash heap,
to seat them with nobles, beside the leaders of his people.
He gives the woman without children a household of her own, a glad mother of children. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 114
fields.body_html:
When Israel came out of Egypt

When Israel left Egypt, when the house of Jacob left a people whose speech was strange to them,
Judah became his holy place, Israel the realm he rules.
The sea looked and ran away; the Jordan turned and flowed back.
The mountains sprang about like rams, the hills like lambs from the flock.
What is wrong, sea, that you run away? Jordan, why do you turn back?
Mountains, why do you spring about like rams, and you hills, like lambs from the flock?
Earth, shake with fear before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who changed the rock into a pool of water, and hard flint into a flowing spring.

fields.title: Psalm 115
fields.body_html:
Not to us, but to your name

Do not give us the glory, LORD, do not give it to us. Give it to your name, for the sake of your loyal love and your faithfulness.
Why should the nations be allowed to say, “So where is their God?”
Yet our God is in the heavens, and whatever he wills, he does.
Their idols are made of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
They have a mouth, yet say nothing; they have eyes, yet see nothing.
They have ears, yet hear nothing; they have a nose, yet smell nothing.
They have hands, yet feel nothing; feet, yet never walk; no sound comes from their throats.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who relies on them.
People of Israel, put your trust in the LORD! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
House of Aaron, put your trust in the LORD! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
You who fear the LORD, put your trust in the LORD! He is the one who helps them and shields them.
The LORD has kept us in mind, and he will bless: he will bless the people of Israel, he will bless the family of Aaron.
He will bless all who fear the LORD, the least of them and the greatest alike.
May the LORD make you grow in number, you and your children too.
You are blessed by the LORD, the one who made the heavens and the earth.
The heavens are the LORD’s own heavens; the earth he has handed over to humankind.
The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who sink down into the silence.
As for us, we will bless the LORD now and for all time to come. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 116
fields.body_html:
I love the LORD, who heard me

I love the LORD, for he listens when I call to him and plead for mercy.
Because he has turned his ear toward me, I will call to him all my days.
The ropes of death were wound around me, and the anguish of Sheol had caught me; I met with distress and grief.
So I cried out to the LORD by name: Please, LORD, save my life!
The LORD shows grace and does what is right; our God is tender and merciful.
The LORD keeps watch over people with no defense; when I sank down helpless, he rescued me.
Come back to your rest, my soul, because the LORD has treated you with kindness.
You have pulled me back from death, kept my eyes from weeping and my feet from tripping.
I will go about my life in the presence of the LORD, here in the lands of the living.
I kept my faith even when I said, I am suffering terribly.
In my panic I said, Every human being is false.
What return can I make to the LORD for all his kindness to me?
I will lift high the cup of salvation and call out the name of the LORD.
What I promised the LORD I will carry out, with all his people looking on.
The death of his loyal ones weighs heavily in the sight of the LORD.
Yes, LORD, I belong to you as your servant, a servant born to your servant woman; you have untied the ropes that bound me.
I will bring you a thank offering and call on the LORD by name.
What I promised the LORD I will carry out, with all his people looking on,
in the courts of the LORD’s house, within you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 117
fields.body_html:
All nations, praise the LORD

Praise the LORD, every nation! Sing his praises, all you peoples!
For his loyal love toward us is overwhelming, and the LORD stays faithful forever. Praise the LORD!

fields.title: Psalm 118
fields.body_html:
The stone the builders cast aside

Give the LORD thanks, for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever.
Let Israel say it now: “His loyal love lasts forever.”
Let the house of Aaron say it now: “His loyal love lasts forever.”
Let those who fear the LORD say it now: “His loyal love lasts forever.”
When I was hemmed in I called to the LORD; the LORD answered me by bringing me out into open space.
With the LORD for me, I have no fear. What can any human being do to me?
The LORD is with me as my helper, and I will see the downfall of those who hate me.
It is better to make the LORD your refuge than to rely on human beings.
It is better to make the LORD your refuge than to rely on princes.
All the nations closed in around me; in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
They closed in around me, yes, they closed in on every side; in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
They came at me like a swarm of bees, but they burned out like a fire in thornbushes; in the name of the LORD I drove them back.
You shoved me hard to make me fall, but the LORD came to my help.
The LORD is my strength and the theme of my song; he has come to my rescue.
The tents of the righteous ring with glad shouts of rescue: “The right hand of the LORD acts with power!
The right hand of the LORD is raised in triumph; the right hand of the LORD acts with power!”
I am not going to die; I will live and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD disciplined me hard, yet he did not let death take me.
Open the gates of righteousness for me, so I may go in and thank the LORD.
This is the LORD’s gate; those who are righteous may pass through it.
I thank you that you answered me and became my salvation.
The stone the builders cast aside is now the stone at the head of the corner.
This has come from the LORD; we look on it with wonder.
This is the day on which the LORD has acted; let us celebrate and be glad because of it.
LORD, we beg you, save us! LORD, we beg you, give us success!
Blessings on the one who comes in the LORD’s name! Out of the LORD’s house we speak a blessing over you.
The LORD is God; he has given us light. Tie the festival offering with ropes and bring it right to the altar’s horns.
You are my God, so I will thank you; I will exalt you, my God.
Give the LORD thanks, for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever.

fields.title: Psalm 119
fields.body_html:
Your word, my delight and my life

How blessed are those whose way of life is without fault, who walk by the instruction of the LORD!
How blessed are those who hold fast to his decrees and seek him with their whole heart.
They do nothing crooked; they keep to the ways he has shown.
You have laid down your precepts to be kept with all care.
If only my life were set firmly on keeping your statutes!
Then I will not be put to shame, as I keep my eyes on all your commands.
With an honest heart I will give you thanks, as I come to learn your righteous rulings.
I will hold to your statutes; do not leave me wholly alone.
How can the young keep their way of life clean? By taking care to live as your word directs.
I have searched for you with all my heart; do not let me drift away from your commands.
Deep in my heart I have kept your word safe, so that I will not sin against you.
All praise to you, LORD! Teach me your statutes.
Aloud I tell over every ruling you have spoken.
Following your decrees gives me as much joy as all the riches in the world.
I will think deeply about your precepts and keep my eyes on your ways.
Your statutes are my joy; I will not let your word slip from my mind.
Treat your servant with kindness, and I will live and hold to your word.
Take the veil from my eyes, so that I may see the wonders in your instruction.
I am only a foreigner living on the earth; do not keep your commands hidden from me.
I am worn thin by longing for your rulings, every hour.
You rebuke the proud, the people under a curse who wander away from your commands.
Lift insult and contempt off me, for I have held to your decrees.
Even when men in power sit and talk against me, your servant keeps thinking about your statutes.
Yes, I delight in your decrees; they are the advisers I listen to.
I lie pressed down in the dust; give me life, as your word has said.
I laid my life out before you, and you gave me an answer; teach me your statutes.
Help me grasp the path your precepts mark out, and I will ponder your wonderful deeds.
I am melting away in sorrow; lift me up as your word has said.
Keep me far from every false path, and be gracious to me by giving me your instruction.
The path of faithfulness is the one I have chosen; I have set your rulings in front of me.
I have held tight to your decrees, LORD; let me not be disgraced.
I will run along the path of your commands, for you open my heart wide.
Show me, LORD, the path of your statutes, and I will hold to it to the very end.
Make me understand, and I will guard your instruction and keep it wholeheartedly.
Guide me along the track of your commands, for that is where my delight is.
Bend my heart toward your decrees, not toward greedy profit.
Turn my eyes from gazing at empty things; keep me alive as I walk in your ways.
Make good your promise to your servant, so that you will be feared.
Turn aside the scorn I fear so much, for your rulings are good.
See how I long for your precepts! Keep me alive in your righteousness.
Let your loyal love reach me, LORD, and your rescue, as your promise assured me.
Then I will have a reply for the one who mocks me, because I rely on your word.
Do not take the word of truth wholly from my mouth, for I have waited in hope for your rulings.
I will keep your instruction always, for all time to come.
I will walk where there is room and freedom, because I have searched for your precepts.
I will talk about your decrees in front of kings and not be put to shame.
I will find my joy in your commands, because I love them.
I will raise my hands toward your commands, which I love, and I will ponder your statutes.
Keep in mind the word you gave your servant; you have made me hope in it.
Here is my comfort when I am brought low: your promise has kept me alive.
The proud have heaped scorn on me without limit, yet I have not swerved from your instruction.
I call to mind your rulings from long ago, LORD, and I find comfort.
Because of the wicked, who have abandoned your instruction, a hot anger takes hold of me.
Your statutes have become my songs in every place where I live as a foreigner.
Through the night I think of your name, LORD, and I hold to your instruction.
This has been my part in life: I have held to your precepts.
The LORD is my share in life; I have said that I will hold to your words.
With my whole heart I have pleaded for your favor; show me kindness, just as your promise said.
I have thought hard about how I live, and turned my steps back to your decrees.
Quickly, without waiting, I set myself to keep your commands.
The wicked have tangled me in their ropes, but I have not forgotten your instruction.
In the middle of the night I get up to thank you for your righteous rulings.
I stand with all who fear you, with everyone who holds to your precepts.
LORD, your loyal love fills all the earth; teach me your statutes.
LORD, you have treated your servant well, just as your word said.
Train me in good sense and knowledge, for I rely on your commands.
Until I was brought low, I kept wandering off; but now I hold to your word.
You are good, and you bring about good; teach me your statutes.
The proud have plastered lies all over me, but with my whole heart I hold to your precepts.
Their hearts are thick and dull as fat, but I delight in your instruction.
It did me good to be brought low, so that I would learn your statutes.
The instruction you have spoken is worth more to me than gold and silver by the thousand.
Your hands made me and shaped me; give me insight, so that I can learn your commands.
Those who fear you will be glad when they see me, for I have set my hope on your word.
I know, LORD, that your rulings are just, and that you brought me low because you are faithful.
Let your loyal love comfort me, I pray, as your promise to your servant said.
Send your tender mercy to me so that I may live; your instruction is what I delight in.
Let the proud be disgraced, for they have twisted the truth to harm me; but I will ponder your precepts.
Let those who fear you come back to me, those who know your decrees.
Let my heart be whole in keeping your statutes, so that I will not be disgraced.
I am worn out with longing for your rescue; I have set my hope on your word.
My eyes grow dim as I watch for your promise; I keep asking when you will comfort me.
I am like a skin bottle dried and cracked in the smoke, yet your statutes have not slipped my mind.
How many days does your servant have left? When will you judge those who hunt me down?
The proud have dug pits to catch me, people who do not live by your instruction.
All your commands can be trusted; people hunt me down with lies. Help me!
They came close to finishing me off in the land, yet I have not let go of your precepts.
Keep me alive in your loyal love, and I will hold to the decree you have spoken.
LORD, your word lasts forever; it is fixed in place in the heavens.
Your faithfulness lasts from one generation to the next; you set the earth in its place, and it remains.
They stand today by your rulings, since all things are your servants.
Had I not taken delight in your instruction, I would have died in my trouble.
Never will I forget your precepts, for you have used them to give me life.
I belong to you; save me, for I have searched out your precepts.
The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I keep my mind on your decrees.
I have seen that every perfect thing has its limit, but your command reaches wide beyond measure.
How I love your instruction! I turn it over in my mind all day long.
Through your commands I grow wiser than my enemies, since they are mine forever.
I see more deeply than all my teachers, because your decrees fill my thoughts.
I understand more than the old, because I have kept your precepts.
I have held my feet back from every wicked road, so that I may keep your word.
I have not strayed from your rulings, for you yourself have been my teacher.
How sweet your words taste to me, sweeter than honey on my tongue!
Through your precepts I gain understanding, so I hate every road built on lies.
Your word is a lamp to guide my feet and a light for the road I travel.
I have sworn an oath and I stand by it: I will keep your righteous rulings.
I am bowed down with trouble; LORD, give me life as your word has said.
LORD, please accept the praise I freely offer, and teach me your rulings.
Every day my life hangs in the balance, yet I do not forget your instruction.
The wicked spread a trap to catch me, yet I have not wandered from your precepts.
I have received your decrees as my portion for all time; they make my heart glad.
I have turned my heart to carry out your statutes for all time, to the very end.
I hate people whose loyalty is divided, but I love your instruction.
In you I find my hiding place and my shield; my hope is fixed on your word.
Get away from me, you evildoers! I mean to keep the commands my God has given.
Hold me up as you have promised, so that I may live; do not let my hope end in shame.
Hold me fast, and I will be safe; I will keep my eyes on your statutes always.
You throw aside all who wander from your statutes, for their cunning is an empty lie.
All the wicked of the earth you throw away like dross; that is why I love your decrees.
My skin crawls with dread of you, and your rulings fill me with fear.
I have done what is fair and just; do not give me up to those who oppress me.
Pledge yourself for your servant’s good; do not let the proud crush me.
My eyes grow weary as I watch for your salvation and for the righteous promise you made.
Treat your servant as your loyal love moves you, and teach me your statutes.
I am your servant; make me understand, so that I come to know your decrees.
The time has come for the LORD to act, for people have broken your instruction.
So I love your commands above gold, above the finest gold.
So I hold all your precepts to be right in everything; I hate every road built on lies.
Your decrees are full of wonder; that is why I keep them with all my being.
When your words are opened up, they shed light; they bring understanding to the naive.
I gasp for breath with my mouth wide open, so deeply do I long for your commands.
Turn toward me and be gracious, as is your way with those who love your name.
Keep my steps steady by your word, and let no evil be master over me.
Set me free when people oppress me, and I will keep your precepts.
Turn the light of your face toward your servant, and train me in your statutes.
My eyes pour out streams of water, because people do not keep your instruction.
LORD, you are just in all you do, and your rulings are straight and true.
You have laid down your decrees in righteousness and in complete faithfulness.
My zeal burns me up, for my enemies have forgotten your words.
Your word has been tried in the fire and found pure, and your servant loves it.
I am of no account and scorned, yet I have not forgotten your precepts.
Your righteousness stays right for all time, and your instruction is the truth.
Trouble and hardship have overtaken me, yet your commands are my joy.
Your decrees are right for all time; help me understand, so that I may live.
With my whole heart I call to you; LORD, answer me! I will keep your statutes.
I cry to you: save me, and I will hold to your decrees.
Before the light of dawn I am up, crying out for help; my hope is in your word.
My eyes are open before each watch of the night, so that I may ponder your promise.
Hear my voice because of your loyal love; LORD, give me life in keeping with your justice.
Those who chase after wicked schemes are closing in; your instruction is far from their minds.
But you, LORD, are close at hand, and every one of your commands is truth.
From your decrees I have known for a long time that you laid their foundations to last forever.
Look at my suffering and pull me out of it, for I have not forgotten your instruction.
Take up my cause and set me free; give me life as you have promised.
The wicked are a long way from being saved, since they never look for your statutes.
Great is your compassion, LORD; give me life as your rulings direct.
Many people hunt me and stand against me, yet I have not swerved from your decrees.
When I see traitors I feel sick, for they have not kept your word.
Look how much I love your precepts! LORD, give me life because of your loyal love.
Your word is truth from first to last; each of your righteous rulings stands forever.
Rulers hunt me down for no reason, but it is your word that makes my heart tremble.
Your promise makes me glad, as glad as one who carries off rich plunder.
I hate lies, I detest them, but I love your instruction.
I praise you seven times every day because your rulings are righteous.
Those who love your instruction enjoy deep peace, and nothing trips them up.
LORD, I look in hope for your salvation, and I carry out your commands.
With all my being I keep your decrees, and I love them deeply.
I keep your precepts and your decrees, for everything I do lies open before you.
LORD, let my cry come close to you; give me understanding as your word has said.
Let my prayer for mercy reach you; rescue me as you have promised.
Let praise bubble up from my lips, for you teach me your statutes.
Let my tongue answer with songs about your word, since every command you give is right.
Reach out your hand to help me, since your precepts are what I have chosen.
LORD, I yearn for you to save me, and your instruction is my joy.
Keep me alive to praise you, and let your rulings come to my aid.
Like a lost sheep I have wandered off; search for your servant, since your commands have not slipped from my mind.

fields.title: Psalm 120
fields.body_html:
Living among people who hate peace

A song of ascents.

When I was in trouble I cried out to the LORD, and he gave me an answer.
LORD, rescue me from people whose lips tell lies, whose tongues deceive.
You deceitful tongue, what will he give you, and what more will he heap on you?
Sharpened arrows from a fighter’s bow, and hot coals of broom wood!
How miserable I am, living as a foreigner in Meshech, making my home among the tents of Kedar!
For far too long I have had to live beside people who hate peace.
I stand for peace, but when I open my mouth, they choose war.

fields.title: Psalm 121
fields.body_html:
The LORD guards your going and coming

A song of ascents.

I look up to the mountains.
Where will my help come from?
My help is from the LORD,
the one who made heaven and earth.
May he never let your foot stumble;
may the one who guards you never doze.
Indeed, the one who guards Israel
never dozes off and never sleeps.
The LORD is the one who guards you;
The LORD is shade at your right side.
By day the sun will not beat down on you,
and by night the moon will do you no harm.
The LORD will guard you against every harm;
he will guard your very life.
The LORD will guard you as you set out and as you return,
from now on and for all time.

fields.title: Psalm 122
fields.body_html:
Pray for Jerusalem’s peace

A song of ascents. Of David.

I was full of joy when they said to me, “Come, let us set out for the house of the LORD!”
Now here we are, standing inside your gates, Jerusalem!
Jerusalem, built as a city whose buildings are joined close together,
where the tribes make their way up, the tribes that belong to the LORD, as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there the seats of justice are placed, the royal thrones of David’s family.
Pray that Jerusalem will have peace: “May all who love you live at ease.
Let your walls be at peace and your strongholds be secure.”
For the sake of my brothers and sisters and my friends I will say, “May peace be inside you!”
Because the house of the LORD our God is here, I will work for what is good for you.

fields.title: Psalm 123
fields.body_html:
Eyes on the LORD, like a servant’s on a master

A song of ascents.

I raise my eyes to you, the one who reigns in heaven.
Servants watch the hand of their master, and a servant woman watches the hand of the woman she serves. In the same way we keep our eyes on the LORD our God, waiting for him to show us favor.
Show us favor, LORD, show us favor, for we have swallowed more contempt than we can bear.
We have had our fill and more of the mockery of the comfortable and the contempt of the arrogant.

fields.title: Psalm 124
fields.body_html:
If the LORD had not been on our side

A song of ascents. Of David.

Let Israel say it now: if the LORD had not stood with us,
if the LORD had not stood with us when people rose up against us,
then they would have devoured us alive in the heat of their anger against us,
then the floodwaters would have carried us off, a torrent would have rushed over us,
then the raging waters would have closed over us.
Blessed be the LORD! He did not give us up to be torn apart by their teeth.
We have slipped free like a bird from the bird-catchers’ trap; the trap is broken, and we are free!
We find our help in the name of the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.

fields.title: Psalm 125
fields.body_html:
Like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken

A song of ascents.

Whoever trusts in the LORD is like Mount Zion: nothing can shake it; it stays in place forever.
Mountains ring Jerusalem all around, and the LORD is all around his people, from now on and forever.
Wicked rule will not stay in place over the land that belongs to the righteous, or even the righteous might reach out their hands to do wrong.
LORD, be good to good people, to all whose hearts are upright.
But as for people who wander off onto crooked paths, the LORD will drive them away with all who do evil. May Israel have peace!

fields.title: Psalm 126
fields.body_html:
Bring us back like streams in the Negev

A song of ascents.

When the LORD turned things around for Zion, we were like people in a dream.
Then we laughed and laughed, and our tongues rang with joyful shouts. Then people among the nations said, “What great things the LORD has done for them!”
Great things indeed the LORD has done for us, and how glad we were!
LORD, restore us again, as the rains bring the dry streams of the Negev back to life.
People who sow their seed in tears will bring in the harvest with songs of joy.
People may go out in tears as they carry the seed for sowing, but they will surely come home shouting for joy, their arms full of sheaves.

fields.title: Psalm 127
fields.body_html:
Unless the LORD builds the house

A song of ascents. Of Solomon.

If the LORD does not build the house, the work of its builders comes to nothing. If the LORD does not guard the city, the watchman’s sleepless night is wasted.
It does you no good to get up early and stay up late, eating food earned by anxious work; he gives sleep to the one he loves.
Children are a gift handed down from the LORD; the fruit of the womb is a reward.
Children born to the young are like arrows in a fighter’s hand.
How blessed is the one who has a quiver filled with them! They will not be disgraced when they argue with enemies at the city gate.

fields.title: Psalm 128
fields.body_html:
The blessing on those who fear the LORD

A song of ascents.

How blessed is everyone who fears the LORD and lives the way he directs!
You will enjoy the food your own hands have worked for; how blessed you will be, and how good your life!
In the heart of your home your wife will be like a vine loaded with grapes, and around your table your children will be like young olive plants.
See how the one who fears the LORD will be blessed!
May the LORD send you blessing from Zion, and may you look on Jerusalem’s good fortune as long as you live,
and may you live long enough to see your grandchildren. May Israel have peace!

fields.title: Psalm 129
fields.body_html:
Attacked often, never defeated

A song of ascents.

Again and again they have attacked me since I was young — let Israel say it now.
Again and again they have attacked me since I was young, but they have never beaten me.
They ran their plows over my back and cut long furrows in it.
The LORD does what is right: he has cut through the ropes of the wicked.
May everyone who hates Zion be disgraced and driven back.
May they be like grass growing on a roof, which dries up before it can grow tall,
too little to fill a reaper’s hand or to make an armful for the one who ties the sheaves,
and no one passing by calls out, “The LORD’s blessing be on you! We bless you in the name of the LORD!”

fields.title: Psalm 130
fields.body_html:
Out of the depths, waiting for the Lord

A song of ascents.

From the deep waters I call to you, LORD.
Lord, listen to me as I call! Turn your ears toward my cry for mercy.
LORD, if you kept count of every wrong, Lord, who could stand before you?
But forgiveness is found with you, and so you are held in awe.
